_docs: Per-component allowlist for the local skill security checker (scripts/mcp_scan_checker.py). Maps a skill path (relative to repo root, e.g. 'skills/<name>') to the issue codes that are acceptable for that skill and the external domains it legitimately references. Issue codes: SECRET (hard-coded private keys/tokens), INJECT (prompt injection), EXEC (download-and-execute). Each entry MUST include a 'reason' justifying why the finding is a false positive or by-design behavior. If a skill introduces a new external domain not listed under 'domains', the allowlist entry will NOT suppress the finding and the check fails (domain census). Placeholder domains (example.com, myapp.com, localhost, etc.) are excluded from validation. Start empty; add entries only after triaging a real finding. Schema: 'components' is a list of { path, allow: [codes], domains: [hosts], reason }.
